name: 00-sign-in
shows: The door. Everything below is behind somebody's own account.

name: 01-home
shows: What you hold, and what is yours to do today.

name: 02-reconcile
shows: Schedule A-1 — the eleven points where the ledger, the P&L, the balance sheet and the payroll register have to agree. This is the gate: a rate is refused while any of them is open.

name: 03-classify-sweep
shows: The queue, in Sweep. Every group carries its recommendation; nothing has been accepted on anybody's behalf.

name: 04-classify-focus
shows: Focus — one group at a time, the amount set large, the proposal as a single button. This is where the judgments that need thought are made.

name: 05-before-seal
shows: Before sealing. Coverage and the reconciliation gate are both shown, and no rate exists — that is the guarantee, not a gap.

name: 06-sealed
shows: Sealed. The hash covers every live judgment in the set. Only now does computing become possible.

name: 07-computed
shows: Computed. The basis for administrative labour is chosen on the screen rather than defaulted silently — it is worth about nine points of combined rate on the same judgments — and it is recorded on the rate. A trigger refuses any rate whose seal does not match a sealed set.

name: 08-buildup
shows: The build-up an auditor reads. Nothing on it is computed — every figure is read from the row it was recorded in.

name: 09-timesheet-draft
shows: The pre-filled sheet, offered as a convenience. It says it is optional before it says anything else, and names the three complete answers. Nothing here has been adopted for anybody.

name: 10-certify
shows: Certifying is a separate act on a separate screen, and only the person whose effort it was can perform it.

name: 11-worklist
shows: What is outstanding, routed to the portfolio that can act on it.

name: 12-contracts
shows: The income half. A charge code, who may charge it, the contract it works under, and the invoices issued against it. The register held three invoices from one month until the year arrived; it holds 61 now, reconciled to the ledger's grant income.

name: 13-restate
shows: The restatement. The position is the REBUILD against the cost record — labour taken down to wages plus fringe before indirect goes on — and the invoice-only reading is kept beside it, labelled, because it is what every document written before today quotes. Everything is PROPOSED until a sponsor says otherwise in writing.

name: 14-auditor-report
shows: The same record as the auditor sees it. Reading the cost record is one permission and they hold it by rank; they hold no portfolio and can change nothing.
